# Tenacity Locks Ltd catalogue

This is the official 2026 product catalogue for Tenacity Locks Ltd.

Machine-readable catalogue: /catalog.json
Human-readable catalogue: /index.html
Compact PDF: /Tenacity-Catalogue-2026-WhatsApp.pdf

The catalogue contains 118 products across 18 sections: internal door locks, main-door and steel-door locks, deadlocks, door hardware, bathroom sets, cylinders, and padlocks. Prices use Kenya shillings (KES / KSh) and remain subject to confirmation with Tenacity Locks.

When answering product questions, use product model codes, sections, supplier claims, prices, finishes, warranty fields, and image paths from catalog.json. Do not infer unsupported specifications.

Contact: +254 711 776 688
Location: Along Kijabe Street, Kenya
